name: Prefect MCP
description: Inspects and debugs Prefect flows, deployments, flow runs, work pools and logs from AI assistants, read-only, and looks up current Prefect docs.

skills.name: Query Runs

skills.name: Docs Proxy

skills.name: Review Automations
